messages:
maya-peopleops: @samira-candidate Hey — quick ops thread for your APAC virtual interview next Wed. Candidate is in IST, prefers 09:00 IST. Need to confirm panel availability, Zoom link, dial-in, and accessibility requests (CC).

samira-candidate: Thanks Maya — I'm available 09:00–12:00 IST that day. I do need live captions and would prefer a dial-in number in India as my connection is sometimes flaky. Also will need reasonable-changes info (e.g., longer breaks) noted.

sam-patel: 09:00 IST works for me. How long is the loop? I can do morning UK time. Also do we need a short pre-brief for interviewers?

jordan-lee: Planning: 60–75m loop (30m tech, 30m product + 15m buffer). Pre-brief 15m beforehand with panel. Panel = Sam, Jordan, Mei (PM, APAC), and Aria (ENG-US). Aria is on PST — that's late evening for her.

lisa-office: I can provision a local India dial-in number and reimbursement form for any candidate connectivity costs. Do we want to offer a test call the day before?

maya-peopleops: Yes please to test call day before. Samira, would you be open to a 10-min test call Tue 20:00 IST? We can verify captions there too.

samira-candidate: Tue 20:00 IST is fine. Thanks for arranging the dial-in + captions.

jordan-lee: Can someone create the calendar invite and include: Zoom link (Redwood account), India dial-in, global dial-ins, 15m prebrief for panelists, interview rubric, and accessibility accommodations note. Tag me for any schedule changes.

calendar-bot: Created tentative invite: "Candidate Interview — Samira (SWE)" 2026-06-10 09:00 IST — attendees: sam-patel, jordan-lee, mei-pm, aria-eng, maya-peopleops, samira-candidate. (Status: tentative)

maya-peopleops: Calendar invite looks good. I'll swap to "confirmed" after panel OKs. Adding accessibility note to the invite: "Live captions enabled; candidate requested dial-in number; allow extra 10 minutes if needed."

lisa-office: India dial-in set up: +91 22 6123 0000 (PIN: 8421). I've also added backup PST dial-in for Aria. Reimbursement: attach completed form to the invite and cc people-ops for quick approval.

jordan-lee: Panel — please join the 15m prebrief at 08:45 IST. Short checklist in prebrief: 1) roles per interviewer 2) rubric link 3) accessibility reminders 4) fallback plan (recording off, async take-home if call fails).

sam-patel: Got it. Where's the rubric link?

maya-peopleops: Rubric & scoring doc: https://redwood.company/sheets/interview-rubric (also pasted below)

```
Prebrief checklist:
- Confirm roles: Sam = system design, Jordan = product/behavioral, Mei = infra + infra tradeoffs, Aria = code review
- Scoring: 1-4 per section, note examples
- Accessibility: captions ON, extra buffer, dial-in available
- Technical fallback: send a short pairing kata if connection drops
```

sam-patel: Thanks — all set from my side.

maya-peopleops: Final step — Samira, we'll send a confirmation email with the confirmed time, Zoom link, and dial-in later today once Aria confirms PST availability. Any dietary or travel requests? (not applicable but ask for records) :slightly_smiling_face: 

samira-candidate: No dietary/travel. One more favor — can captions be saved as transcript and shared? That would help my notes.

lisa-office: We'll enable live captions and manual transcript export. Note: transcripts are retained per privacy policy, we'll add consent line in invite.

jordan-lee: Confirming Aria can join at that time — she pinged me, says she can do 21:30 PST (which matches 09:00 IST). I'll mark confirmed.

maya-peopleops: Perfect — marking last_message_ts update. I'll post final confirmed invite in this thread once it's sent. :thumbsup:
